verdict.rationale: Docs describe ingesting arbitrary 'text, files, or URLs' with a single .remember call and later recalling via .recall/search (cognee-docs-16, cognee-docs-41, cognee-docs-43, cognee-docs-37), which implies PDF/image support as generic file inputs, but no evidence explicitly confirms image or PDF-specific parsing/OCR pipelines or shows a hands-on example recalling from such files. Missing for 10: explicit documentation naming image/PDF ingestion formats, and independent/hands-on verification that non-text files are actually parsed and recallable.
